name: Second Beach concession canopy and facilities
camera_derivation: Target is the mean traced canopy curve moved halfway toward its inner facade; target height is the mean of sampled ground and roof levels. Eye is 18 m west of the westmost canopy point, 6 m north of its mean northing, and 2.25 m above the mean sampled ground. The north-west view avoids the separate small pool-deck kiosk.
view_scope: Supplemental facility form and solid-colour shading review only. This is not a route view or route-visibility proof. Actual occlusion still requires image inspection.
